title: SocialPersona - Data API
description: Represents a snapshot of a contact's profile on a social network such as Facebook or Twitter. This object is available in API version 22.0 and later.

AreWeFollowing.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
AreWeFollowing.description: Specifies whether a Salesforce social account is following the social persona or not.

AuthorLabels.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AuthorLabels.description: Comma-separated list of author type tags.

AvatarUrl.description: Retrieves the user's social network avatar. It's a read-only field and you can't specify or update its value.

ExternalId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalId.description: ID of the social persona on the social network.

ExternalPictureURL.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalPictureURL.description: URL to the picture of the social persona on the social network.

Followers.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Followers.description: Number of followers that the social persona has.

Following.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Following.description: Number of people that the social persona is following.

InfluencerScore.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InfluencerScore.description: Radian6 score describing the influence of the social persona. No longer used.

IsBlacklisted.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsBlacklisted.description: Specifies whether the social persona is blacklisted or not.

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Specifies whether the social persona supplies the default avatar image that’s displayed on the contact or account.

IsFollowingUs.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsFollowingUs.description: Specifies whether the social persona is following a Salesforce social account or not.

IsVerified.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsVerified.description: Specifies whether the social persona is verified or not.

LastReferencedDate.description: Date and time when the social persona was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and time when the social persona was last viewed.

ListedCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

MediaProvider.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MediaProvider.description: Social network of the social persona.

MediaType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MediaType.description: Social network type of the social persona.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

NumberOfFriends.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NumberOfFriends.description: Number of friends that the social persona has.

NumberOfTweets.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NumberOfTweets.description: Number of tweets made by the social persona.

ParentId.description: ID of the contact parent record for the social persona. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProfileType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProfileType.description: Type of profile. Values are: Person Page

ProfileUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Provider.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Provider.description: Social network, such as Facebook or Twitter, of the social persona.

R6SourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
R6SourceId.description: ID of the social persona in Social Studio.

RealName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RealName.description: Real name of the social persona.

SourceApp.description: Salesforce product that created the social persona.

TopicType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TopicType.description: Type of topic, such as keyword or managed.

usage:
The fields on a SocialPersona object don’t provide real-time data. They provide a snapshot of information from the last time Salesforce collected a post from the social persona. Many of the Radian6-related fields are no longer accurate or used.
